steps.title: Build a farm plot at home
steps.hints: Call buildables, look for a Farming Plot or Ash Farming Plot, and build the one he has materials for beside him. Pick a flat spot near home.

steps.title: Plant the wheat seeds
steps.hints: tend the new plot with Wheat Seeds. Plant both seeds if there are two plots, otherwise one.

steps.title: Let the wheat grow
steps.hints: Stay near home. Use farm_plots to see when it is ready.

steps.title: Harvest the wheat
steps.hints: tend the plot with nothing in hand. If it isn't ready, wait and retry.

steps.title: Get a Grinder and make flour
steps.hints: Use buildables to find a Grinder (or Mill) piece and build it. Then craft Bag of Flour from Wheat. If the Grinder can't be built, ask the player.

steps.title: Get a Kiln and bake bread
steps.hints: Check buildables for what is missing. Gather clay, and ash or stone as needed. Build the Kiln, put in fuel if it asks, then craft Bread from the flour.

events.description: Build a farm plot at home, grow wheat, then grind it to flour and bake bread
events.explanation: Wheat seeds are in the bag (2) and so are ash logs and stone for building a plot. Bread needs Wheat, then Bag of Flour at a Grinder, then Bread at a Kiln. The Kiln build needs clay and fire runes, which he lacks, so those steps may need more gathering.
steps: Build a farm plot at home
